# situation: a step sets its output version with the workflow command
#   ::set-output.
# reason: the runner adds a warning to every run of the step, and the step
#   sets no output once GitHub disables set-output, which GitHub planned and
#   postponed.
on: workflow_call
permissions: {contents: read}
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - id: version
        run: echo "::set-output name=version::$(cat VERSION)"
      - run: echo "building ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
